blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A sharp decline in principal repayments eased the government’s debt service burden in September, more than offsetting higher interest expenses, the Bureau of the Treasury said. The government spent P207.5 billion to service its debt during the month, down 36.7 percent from a year earlier, the latest Treasury data showed. READ: Gov’t debt service falls to P76B in August on lower amortization In the first nine months of the year, the state paid P1.7 trillion in debt service, nearly 12 percent less than in the same period in 2025.
